automationNotes: Doc: https://www.contentstack.com/docs/personalize/add-event-to-ab-test-experience — **Prereq:** Personalize project + **at least one Event** (see doc). Path: **+ New Experience** → **A/B Test** → Overview **Save General Details** → **Configuration** (left nav) → **Metrics** → **+ Add Event** → pick event → **Save**. Reuses A/B draft handlers in **`rules/core/actionRules.ts`**; event pick: **`PERSONALIZE_AB_TEST_METRIC_EVENT_CONTAINS`** (optional; else first option). Project card: **`PERSONALIZE_PROJECT_CARD_CONTAINS`** / **`DAL_PERSONALIZE_PROJECT_SEARCH`**. Doc step **Save** — UI may show **Save Draft**; runner accepts both. DOM: **`create-ab-test-experience.selectors.ts`** patterns (`ab-testing-experience-draft-config-body`).
